reply.subject: RM_Vurra

observed.facings.png: Three facings at one scale on a checkerboard. South: a rounded, domed, segmented body seen head-on. Overlapping khaki-tan armour plates with dark mottling run up the back as a ridge of pointed scutes. In the centre is a round open mouth with a ring of pale hooked fangs under a hood-like head plate, and large pale curved claw-legs splay out at the lower sides. East: a long, thick grub- or larva-like body in side profile. Tan ring segments carry a row of pointed dorsal spines, and a hooded armoured head on the right has an open fanged mouth. Small pale pointed legs run along the belly, and the body tapers to a spiked tail at the left. North: the same domed body from behind. Stacked plates and a dorsal ridge converge to a tapered tail tip at the bottom centre, curved pale legs sit at the sides, and there is no face.
observed.south.png: Full-resolution south: a front view of the domed, plated body with the circular fanged maw centred under a head shield, and pale curved limbs at both lower sides. Clean dark outline, soft painterly shading, transparent background.
observed.east.png: Full-resolution east: a side profile of the segmented larva-like body, about 2:1 long. Dorsal spikes, a hooded head with mandible-like fangs at the right, small spiky legs along the belly, a tapering spined tail at the left. Transparent background.
observed.north.png: Full-resolution north: the rear of the body. Overlapping plates narrow to a pointed tail segment at the bottom centre, with a dorsal ridge of scutes. Pale curved legs at the sides. No eyes or mouth. Transparent background.
observed.scale.png: At max zoom the creature spans roughly two cells long and is about two-thirds of the vanilla human's height, lying low on the ground. At 32 px/cell it reads as a tan elongated segmented shape, clearly bigger than the rat and longer than the human.

SOUTH_FRONT.seen: South shows the head-on maw with a ring of fangs under the head shield, facing the camera.

NORTH_REAR.seen: North shows stacked rear plates converging to a tail tip, with no face or eyes.

NO_OVERHEAD.seen: All three are at the oblique game camera: south and north show the dome front and back, east a side profile.

SAME_SIZE.seen: The measured height spread is 10%, within 15%, and the facings look consistent on the shared-scale panel.

SAME_ANIMAL.seen: Same palette, plates, dorsal scutes and maw throughout. The legs look somewhat larger and more claw-like on south and north than the small belly spikes on east, but they read as the same limbs foreshortened.

SIGNATURE.seen: A large alien worm with a threatening head reads clearly: a segmented serpentine body with a fanged maw.

ALIEN.seen: The armour plates, dorsal spines, claw legs and radial fanged maw make it read as an alien larva-worm, not an earthworm or an ordinary grub.

DEPARTURES.seen: 1) Massive: present, about 2 cells long and about two-thirds of human height, bulky. 2) Predator head: present, a hooded head with a ring of hooked fangs. 3) Alien skin: present, khaki armour plates with dark mottling and spines, no pink moist rings and no clitellum.

STYLE.seen: Painterly shading with a clean dark outline. Slightly smooth or illustrative, but not cute and not cel-flat.

OURS.seen: Card provenance: texPath art comes from RimStarWars/SWBestiary, another mod.

ALPHA.seen: Transparent background on all facings, with no ground patch or shadow.

SCALE.seen: Beside the human it is long and heavy enough to threaten a lone traveller, matching 'large enough to threaten a lone traveler'.

LEGIBLE.seen: At 32 px it reads as a tan segmented elongated body, distinct from the ground and the rat.
